# Claude raters on DICES-350, and filling holes (generated by scripts/run_claude_raters.py)

AUC against the expert label on the test half (175 conversations). Few-human rows are means over 20 random draws of humans; the count of draws in which one method beats another is shown instead of a confidence interval (all draws share the same 175 items).
